Title: IPackageManager Contract
Summary: Contract for managing indexed packages from plugin servers with download queue support.
Content:
# IPackageManager Contract

## Namespace
`Cyrena.Extensa.Contracts`

## Purpose
Coordinates package indexing from multiple plugin servers and manages a download queue with support for concurrent downloads, progress tracking, and cancellation.

## Properties

### IndexedPackages
```csharp
IReadOnlyList<IndexedPackage> IndexedPackages { get; }
```
Returns all packages indexed from enabled servers.

### IsIndexing
```csharp
bool IsIndexing { get; }
```
Indicates whether initial indexing is in progress.

### IsRefreshing
```csharp
bool IsRefreshing { get; }
```
Indicates whether a refresh operation is in progress.

### IndexingProgress
```csharp
double IndexingProgress { get; }
```
Progress of the current indexing operation (0.0 to 1.0).

### QueuedDownloadCount
```csharp
int QueuedDownloadCount { get; }
```
Count of downloads that are queued or in progress.

## Methods

### IndexPackagesAsync
```csharp
Task<int> IndexPackagesAsync(
    PackageQueryOptions? options = null,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
```
Indexes all packages from enabled servers concurrently. Returns total package count.

### RefreshIndexAsync
```csharp
Task<int> RefreshIndexAsync(
    PackageQueryOptions? options = null,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
```
Clears the index and re-fetches all packages. Returns total package count after refresh.

### GetIndexedPackage
```csharp
IndexedPackage? GetIndexedPackage(string packageId);
```
Gets a specific package by ID from the index.

### SearchPackages
```csharp
IReadOnlyList<IndexedPackage> SearchPackages(string query);
```
Searches indexed packages by name or description (case-insensitive).

### QueueDownloadAsync
```csharp
Task QueueDownloadAsync(
    string packageId,
    string? version = null,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
```
Adds a package to the download queue. Throws `ArgumentException` if package not found.

### CancelDownload
```csharp
bool CancelDownload(string packageId);
```
Cancels a queued or in-progress download. Returns true if found and cancelled.

### GetDownloadQueue
```csharp
IReadOnlyList<DownloadQueueItem> GetDownloadQueue();
```
Returns all items in the download queue, ordered by queue time (newest first).

### ClearCompletedDownloads
```csharp
void ClearCompletedDownloads();
```
Removes completed and cancelled downloads from the queue.

## Types

### IndexedPackage
```csharp
public class IndexedPackage
{
    public required string Id { get; init; }
    public required string Name { get; init; }
    public string? Description { get; init; }
    public required string ServerId { get; init; }
    public required string ServerName { get; init; }
    public IReadOnlyList<PackageVersion> Versions { get; init; }
}
```

### DownloadQueueItem
```csharp
public record DownloadQueueItem
{
    public required string QueueId { get; init; }
    public required IndexedPackage Package { get; init; }
    public string? Version { get; init; }
    public required DownloadStatus Status { get; init; }
    public double Progress { get; init; }
    public string? ErrorMessage { get; init; }
    public DateTimeOffset QueuedAt { get; init; }
}
```

### DownloadStatus
```csharp
public enum DownloadStatus
{
    Queued,
    Downloading,
    Completed,
    Failed,
    Cancelled
}
```

## Behavior

- **Concurrent Downloads**: Maximum 2 downloads processed simultaneously using a semaphore.
- **Auto Re-indexing**: Subscribes to `IPluginServerService.ServersChanged` to invalidate index when servers change.
- **Idempotent Queuing**: Prevents duplicate downloads of the same package/version.
- **Cancellation Support**: Download cancellation via linked cancellation tokens.
